# Trung Nguyen — Founder Bottleneck Diagnostician

> Trung Nguyen is a Founder Bottleneck Diagnostician who runs 90-minute diagnostics for post-MVP founder-led companies with 3–20 people, finding and naming the constraint behind stalled decisions, execution and growth.

Not the Vietnamese coffee entrepreneur of the same name. This Trung Nguyen is a Vietnamese-German
engineer turned diagnostician based in Berlin.

## Core pages

- [About Trung Nguyen](https://iamtrung.com/about): who he is, who he works with, background, and where to verify his work
- [Founder Bottleneck Diagnostic](https://iamtrung.com/founder-diagnostic): what the 90-minute session is, how it runs, and what founders say afterwards
- [Home](https://iamtrung.com/): overview and entry point

## Essays

- [What happens during a Founder Bottleneck Diagnostic?](https://iamtrung.com/essays/what-happens-in-a-diagnostic): the session step by step, who it's for, and a decision rule
- [How do I know if I'm the bottleneck in my company?](https://iamtrung.com/essays/founder-is-the-bottleneck): the two-week test and the five everyday signs of founder-dependency

## Case studies

- [The agency founder who got back 10–15 hours a week](https://iamtrung.com/case-studies/algomate-10-hours-a-week): fast proof — result landed the same week (named, with permission)
- [The founder who never opened his dashboard](https://iamtrung.com/case-studies/the-dashboard-he-never-opened): durable proof — funnel numbers measured six months after the session (anonymized)
